title: ExchangeMetadata
description: Metadata for exchange and marketplace interactions. Exchanges couple offers and requests through REA agreements with explicit terms and reciprocity expectations.

offerType.description: What is being offered — maps to REA resource specification

requestType.description: What is being requested in return — maps to REA resource specification

expiresAt.description: ISO 8601 datetime when this offer/request expires

reciprocityExpected.description: Whether reciprocal action is expected. False for gifts, true for trades.

resourceNature.description: REA resource nature dimensions for the exchanged resource
